question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Ratepayer Protection Act (H R 9340)
plain_language: This bill tells state utility regulators to consider making very large power users, such as data centers using 100 megawatts or more, pay the full extra cost of grid upgrades built to serve them. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.
